task: Add end-to-end tests for the preferences page (`/`). Acceptance criteria: (1) ticking Dark mode switches the page theme immediately: the `<html>` element's `data-theme` attribute becomes `dark` (and `light` when unticked); (2) Save stores the current choices and shows the status `Preferences saved`; (3) after Save and a reload, the Dark mode checkbox and the Language selection show the saved values; (4) a change that was not saved is lost on reload (the controls return to the stored values); (5) the status message is cleared as soon as either control is changed again. The test seam `POST /api/reset` restores the defaults (light theme, English).

faults.description: The Save button does nothing: no request, no status.
Save stores the language but keeps the previous theme; the status still reads `Preferences saved`.
The status reads `Saved` instead of `Preferences saved`.
Ticking Dark mode saves immediately, so an unsaved change is not lost on reload.
